name: shockwave_beat_show
description: Beat-driven show: Shockwave pulses on point props, shared SingleStrand chases on linear props, 6-layer Spirals/Pinwheel composites on hero props, Text lyrics on matrix, occasional whole-display Pinwheel/Shader accents.

timing.notes: Section durations are exact multiples of 8 beats (2 bars at ~93 BPM); section boundaries snap to the beat grid (15/18 at exactly 0ms), not to lyrics. Beat-pulse props alternate on opposite beats (ping-pong).

beat_pulse.target_props: point props: stars, tree toppers, snowflakes
beat_pulse.pattern: one Shockwave per beat (or per 2 beats), identical settings block reused; alternate props on opposite beats

chase.target_props: linear props: arches, candy canes, house outline lines
chase.pattern: two alternating SingleStrand blocks shared across all linear props so chases sweep in lockstep; ~90% timeline coverage

hero_layered.pattern: 6 layers compositing Spirals + Pinwheel + On + Liquid; carries the visual complexity

lyrics.pattern: Text effect per lyric phrase from timing track

global_accent.pattern: sparse Pinwheel/Shader hits at section transitions
